title: Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2

thread.title: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 • Sasaki to Pii-chan Season 2 - Episode 4 discussion

opinions.point: Many viewers found the episode intense, surprising, and highly engaging, especially praising its dramatic escalation and cliffhanger.
Several commenters felt Season 2 is stronger than Season 1 because of its mysteries, converging storylines, and higher stakes.
The cast received praise for emotionally convincing performances and memorable character dynamics.
Some viewers enjoyed the unusual genre blend and tonal shifts, while others found the show’s eclectic elements and reliance on plot armor questionable.
A few commenters criticized or disliked the simplistic battle presentation and were concerned about the direction of the story.
